question: Compare the 2025 refund rate (refunded orders as a percentage of all orders) of the Online and Direct channels. If the gap is more than 1.5 percentage points, show the 2025 refund rate by region for whichever of the two channels is higher; otherwise, give the overall 2025 refund rate across all channels.
plan: The answer depends on a condition: evaluate the condition first with its own query, then answer only the branch that applies.

sql_attempts.sql: WITH channel_refunds AS (SELECT channel, CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'refunded' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / COUNT(*) * 100 AS refund_pct FROM orders WHERE order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND order_date <= '2025-12-31' AND channel IN ('Online', 'Direct') GROUP BY channel), online_direct_diff AS (SELECT MAX(refund_pct) - MIN(refund_pct) AS gap, CASE WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN channel = 'Online' THEN refund_pct ELSE 0 END) > MAX(CASE WHEN channel = 'Direct' THEN refund_pct ELSE 0 END) THEN 'Online' ELSE 'Direct' END AS higher_channel FROM channel_refunds), region_refunds AS (SELECT r.region_name, CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = 'refunded' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / COUNT(o.order_id) * 100 AS refund_rate FROM orders AS o JOIN customers AS c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN regions AS r ON c.region_id = r.region_id CROSS JOIN online_direct_diff AS d WHERE o.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date <= '2025-12-31' AND o.channel = d.higher_channel AND d.gap > 1.5 GROUP BY r.region_name), fallback AS (SELECT 'Overall' AS region_name, CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'refunded' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / COUNT(*) * 100 AS refund_rate FROM orders WHERE order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND order_date <= '2025-12-31' AND (SELECT gap FROM online_direct_diff) <= 1.5) SELECT region_name, refund_rate FROM region_refunds UNION ALL SELECT region_name, refund_rate FROM fallback WHERE (SELECT gap FROM online_direct_diff) <= 1.5 LIMIT 500
